About me

A relationship of trust, grounded in science

I am Zenia Nikolaou, a licensed psychologist and psychotherapist with a private practice in Vari, Attica. I work mainly with cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) and positive psychology, with teenagers, adults, couples and parents — in person and online.

I studied psychology in Italy and completed two master’s degrees: in Cognitive Behavioural Psychotherapy (University of Central Lancashire) and in Positive Psychology (University of Bolton). For my work with couples I also hold the Professional Diploma in Relationship Counseling from EIU Paris.

A particular field of my training is psychological assessment of personality: I am certified in the use of the MMPI®-3 through ISON Psychometrica. I have clinical experience from working with private mental-health services, and my practice is supported by ongoing clinical supervision.

I also hold a degree in Hellenic Culture from the Hellenic Open University — a wider interest in people and in the social and cultural setting in which our identity and our relationships take shape.

The aim is a safe, collaborative setting in which you can understand your difficulties more deeply and move towards real, lasting change.

My approach

Two lenses, one person

Every treatment plan is shaped around your needs, your goals and your own story.

Cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT)

An evidence-based approach that focuses on the link between what we think, feel and do. Together we recognise the patterns that hold you back and try out, step by step, more helpful ways of coping.

  • Thought
  • Feeling
  • Behaviour

Positive psychology

Therapy is not only about what hurts. Positive psychology studies what makes life worth living: character strengths, meaning, relationships. I use it so that, alongside relief, we also build resilience and self-esteem.

  • Strengths
  • Meaning
  • Resilience

What we can work on

Psychotherapy in Vari for what weighs on you

Depression

When mood, energy and interest have been gone for a long time.

Anxiety disorders & health anxiety

Worry that will not stop, physical symptoms, constant checking.

Panic attacks

Sudden, intense fear — and the fear that it will happen again.

Specific phobias

Fear that limits daily life: heights, travel, animals, needles.

Obsessive-compulsive disorder

Thoughts that keep returning and acts you feel you “must” do.

Grief & adjustment difficulties

Losses, separations, changes that make it hard to find your balance again.

Relationships & sexual life

Difficulties in relationships, in the couple and in sexual life.

Self-esteem & self-image

Harsh self-criticism, low self-confidence, personal growth.

Services

Sessions for teenagers, adults and couples

In person at the office in Vari, or by video call — always 50 minutes.

Call 694 760 1647

Individual psychotherapy for adults

50 minutes · at the office or online

One-to-one sessions based on cognitive behavioural therapy. We start from what troubles you now — anxiety, panic, depression, grief, a difficult change — and shape together a personal treatment plan, with goals that matter to you.

Sessions for teenagers

50 minutes

Adolescence brings strong emotions, pressure at school and among friends, questions about oneself. Sessions give the teenager a safe space of their own to talk, and practical ways to handle anxiety, mood and self-esteem.

Relationship & couples counselling

50 minutes · Professional Diploma, EIU Paris

For couples who want to communicate better, resolve recurring conflicts or find closeness again — and for anyone who wants to understand the patterns they repeat in relationships, without anyone being cast as the one to blame.

Parent counselling

50 minutes

Support for parents facing a difficulty with their child or teenager — behaviour, emotions, boundaries, communication at home. Together we find ways that suit your own family.

Psychological personality assessment

MMPI®-3 · Psychological Check-up™

With the MMPI®-3, an internationally recognised psychometric instrument, personality and possible psychopathology are assessed. The results are discussed with you and give a clear picture of where you stand and how therapy can continue.

Online sessions

50 minutes · video call

All sessions are also available by video call, with the same structure and the same confidentiality — for those who live far from Vari, travel, or prefer to talk from their own space.

Positive psychology in practice

Your well-being map

The PERMA model of positive psychology (Martin Seligman) describes five pillars of well-being. Move the sliders and see your map take shape.

How often do you feel joy, calm, gratitude?

How often do you lose yourself in something absorbing?

How supported do you feel by the people around you?

How much do you feel that what you do matters to you?

How much do you feel you are moving towards your goals?

Your strong point

A small step for

This is a playful moment of self-reflection, not a psychometric test or a diagnosis. Nothing is stored or sent. For a real assessment see the Psychological Check-up below.

Psychological Check-up™

A complete psychological assessment

As a contracted psychologist of ISON Psychometrica’s Psychological Check-up™, I can offer you a complete psychological assessment that maps more than 50 aspects of your life — so that you understand in depth how you think, feel and function, recognise your difficulties and your strengths, and get clear guidance for your therapy.

  • Designed by experienced psychologists and psychiatrists, with 35 years of ISON know-how
  • I am also certified in the MMPI®-3, the internationally recognised personality inventory
  • The results are discussed with you, in person or online

How we begin

Four steps, at your own pace

  1. 1

    Get in touch

    Call or book online. A short conversation is enough to see what you need.

  2. 2

    First session

    We get to know each other and talk about what brings you and what you would like to change. No rush, no judgement.

  3. 3

    Your own plan

    We shape a personal treatment plan, based on your needs, your goals and your own story.

  4. 4

    Change in daily life

    We try new ways of coping and follow your progress together, until the changes become your own.

Questions

Before the first session

Where is the office?

At 27 Artemidos Street in Vari, Attica. Clients come from Vari, Varkiza, Voula, Glyfada, Koropi and the nearby southern suburbs. There is no private parking.

Are sessions available online?

Yes. All sessions — individual, teenagers, couples and parents — are also available by video call, with the same length and the same confidentiality.

How long is a session?

50 minutes. Sessions are usually once a week; how often and for how long is agreed with you, depending on your goals.

What is cognitive behavioural therapy?

It is an evidence-based form of psychotherapy that looks at how our thoughts, feelings and behaviours are linked, and helps change the patterns that keep a difficulty going.

Do you work with couples?

Yes. I offer relationship and couples counselling, with additional training in the field (Professional Diploma in Relationship Counseling, EIU Paris).

What is the Psychological Check-up?

It is a complete psychological assessment by ISON Psychometrica that maps more than 50 aspects of your life and gives guidance for your therapy. I am a contracted psychologist of the programme.

How do I pay?

By card or cash at the office, or online when booking through doctoranytime (Klarna too). You can cancel an appointment up to 24 hours before.

Are you contracted with EOPYY?

Yes, I am contracted with EOPYY, the Greek national health provider. To find out whether and how your case is covered, ask me by phone before your appointment.
